thread:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: elevated decode p99 on streaming inference (us-west-2). Trigger: p99 > 1.2s for 5m, sustained error-rate bump on model-resp. Tags: kernel, trt8, flashquant, compilepath. Priority: P1. @Alex you are oncall.
Alex: Ack, looking. Any recent deploys?
oncall-bot: Recent deploys: 1715495000 - runtime:trt8-flashquant@release-candidate; 1715489000 - compile-flag:update -fno-fastmath -> -Ofast; 1715478000 - kernel:nv-kernel-7.6 rollout (10%->50%).
Maria: I can start tracing decode tail. Datadog panels show p95 ~320ms, p99 ~1.25s, streaming stalls jumping at 1715495200. Looks correlated with runtime rollout window.
Sam: Paging infra checks: disk/paging metrics show increased page-faults on GPU host pool gpool-decode-02. p99 memory-resident-eviction spikes at the same time.
Jordan: Networking looks clean. No egress saturation.
Alex: Maria, can you paste the hot traces? Also which model variants affected?
Maria: Affected mostly large-context v2 models with KV cache heavy uses (seq len 4k). Quick trace snippet: ```TRACE decode: model=v2-large shard=3 kernel=nv-kernel-7.6 trt=k8-flashquant latency=1283ms tail=980ms op=attention::flash_attn```
Sam: Hostlist of affected nodes: gpool-decode-02-{05,07,09,12}. Running `nvidia-smi` shows driver 530.41 and kernel module mismatch warnings on 07.
Alex: Hmm mismatch. deploy-bot shows kernel rollout hit 50% at 1715495400. Could be compilepath change + flashquant kernel exposing eviction path.
Lee: CS reports 3 customers with increased response times and one with a timeout retry storm. I flagged them and asked for mitigation ETA.
Maria: Quick mitigation: enable fallback routing to model=v2-medium-quant and increase prefix cache TTL. That reduces p99 to ~480ms in canary. Should we do cluster-wide?
Alex: Do it for now on us-west-2: route 30% traffic to fallback variant and enable cache. Jordan/Sam coordinate.
Jordan: Doing route change via rollout API: `curl -X POST /routing/adjust -d '{"region":"us-west-2","route":{"v2-large":0.7,"v2-medium-quant":0.3}}'` -> response ok.
Sam: Cache TTL bump: `redis-cli -h cache-usw2 CONFIG SET prefix_ttl 600` -> applied. Observability shows p99 dropping within 2m in the canary pool.
Alex: Good. Customers still impacted partially. Need root cause and permanent fix. Maria, can you triage kernel vs trt?
Maria: I pulled symbols and ran a local repro with sample prompts. With nv-kernel-7.6 + trt8-flashquant we see KV cache eviction loops. Reverting to nv-kernel-7.5 reproduces stable latency. Suspect kernel memory allocator/regression interacting with flash-attn memory pattern.
Sam: We should run `dkms status` and verify module versions across nodes. Also check compile flags used when building trt kernels. The -Ofast change could change FP handling for fused kernels.
Alex: Timeline decision: hotpatch rollback kernel on affected pool to 7.5, pin trt8-flashquant to previous artifact, and revert compile flag in release-candidate. Rollout plan: canary 10% -> 100% on impacted pool. Sam/Jordan own kernel rollback, Maria owns trt pin, I coordinate release flag revert.
deploy-bot: Initiating rollback job 1715500300: kernel:nv-kernel-7.5 -> target gpool-decode-02 nodes {05,07,09,12}. ETA ~8m.
Sam: Starting node01-07 kernel rollback now: `ansible -i hosts gpool-decode-02 -b -m shell -a 'apt-get install nv-kernel-7.5 && reboot'` - kicking reboots.
Maria: Pinning trt artifact: `artifactctl pin trt8-flashquant@2024-11-08-rc2` -> pinned on staging and canary.
Alex: Keep me posted on p99 numbers. Also capture heap/dmesg around page-faults forensics.
Sam: Node 07 back up, nvidia module reports 7.5, no mismatch warnings. p99 on that node dropped to 320ms. Rolling through 09 and 12.
Maria: After pin/trt revert in canary, tail latency decreased further. Full metrics: before mitigation p99 = 1.25s, after routing+cache p99 ~480ms, after kernel rollback + trt pin p99 ~260ms, p95 ~280ms.
Lee: CS notified customers: sent interim status and ETA ~20m for full remediation. They appreciate routing to fallback but want root cause summary after postmortem.
Alex: Good. Next steps: 1) Finish kernel rollback across pool. 2) Revert compile flag in build pipeline and re-run perf tests. 3) Postmortem ticket with timeline + repro + PR to fix allocator/kernel interaction. 4) Kill switch: automatic rollback on p99 > 1s during kernel deploys.
Jordan: I'll add the rollback kill-switch to deployment runbook and wire an alert.
CS-Bot: Customer ticket #C-1248 updated: "We applied a temporary fallback routing and the issue is being actively mitigated by infra engineers. We'll follow up once fully resolved."
Alex: Thanks team. No further action for oncall after full rollback. I'll handoff to eng-sre for postmortem tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Maria: I'll capture heap traces + repro steps and attach to the postmortem.
Sam: Logs/artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-incident-logs/1715500000/ - includes dmesg, nvidia-smi outputs, and kdumps.
Alex: Closing oncall loop for this thread. Follow-up assigned in ticket INF-4321.
notes: incident was a kernel/allocator regression interacting with trt8 flashquant kernels and a compile flag change; mitigations included routing fallback, prefix cache TTL increase, kernel rollback, trt artifact pin, and compile-flag revert. Postmortem to be created by eng-sre.
